_doc: W2-A-LEAVES (2026-11-12): THE POOL TABLE. Every pool of the state-prose corpus and its LAYER on the procedure's scale (SOP-POOLS-AND-CONDITIONS §1: a line is one above the highest fact it reads). Rows marked map:<how> took the layer map's placing (lane/layer-map-2026-11-12 at 5f1dd0397, results/layers.json) + 1: the map numbers a pool by the stratum its key reads, so its L1 pool reads the base facts and is a layer-2 line here. Rows marked placed: are this lane's reading of source (the 21 the map could not place). Layer W: the campaign world's desks, outside this release, banked by name. A NEW POOL gets its row here in the commit that adds it, placed by what its key and its lines read; tests/lint/factLayers.walker.test.js reds an unplaced pool and a row whose pool is gone.
